name: Virag Daily Social Design Trends
purpose: Translate current public visual-culture and social-design signals into original Instagram-ready art-direction principles without copying creators, brands or layouts.

sources.name: Pinterest Predicts 2026
sources.use: Broad visual and cultural trend signals.

sources.name: Public social-design signals
sources.use: High-level format, hierarchy and content-behavior observations only; never copy a post.

selectionRule: For each requested output, choose one compatible active trend as a subtle art-direction layer. In a batch, rotate through compatible trends without repeating until all have been used. A trend may shape grid, typography, palette, texture and graphic devices, but must never override the current user brief, brand identity, readable copy, Pixel-Locked Product Fidelity or Human Studio realism. CLEAN HUMAN OVERRIDE: apply a trend only when it improves the message; reduce it to one dominant device, short copy, strong whitespace and a maximum of two professional font families. If it creates clutter, do not use it. Apply it as one part of a complete Premium Designed composition; never flatten the design into sparse minimalism.

activeTrends.label: Neo-Deco Social Geometry
activeTrends.signal: Modern Art Deco is returning through bold geometry and polished structure.
activeTrends.layout: Asymmetric geometric frame, stepped alignment, one confident arch or fan motif and generous breathing room.
activeTrends.typography: Condensed grotesk or refined editorial serif paired with Inter/Helvetica-style utility copy.
activeTrends.palette: Brand palette first; optional jade, persimmon or pale blue accent.
activeTrends.texture: Subtle paper, brushed metal or print grain—never plastic gloss.
activeTrends.avoid: Literal 1920s imitation, ornamental overload and gold-on-black by default.

activeTrends.label: Tactile Analog Edit
activeTrends.signal: Renewed interest in physical media and handmade craft favors imperfect, touchable visual systems.
activeTrends.layout: Layered cut shapes, imperfect masks, margin notes, taped edges or hand-marked dividers used with restraint.
activeTrends.typography: Real typesetting with one handwritten annotation accent; body copy remains clean and readable.
activeTrends.palette: Warm paper neutrals with one brand-color accent.
activeTrends.texture: Scanned paper fibers, ink variation, soft grain and authentic edge wear.
activeTrends.avoid: Fake scrapbook clutter, excessive torn paper and childish sticker overload.

activeTrends.label: Cool Blue Clarity
activeTrends.signal: Pale cool blue is rising as a calm, wellness and clarity color.
activeTrends.layout: Airy modular grid, translucent information cards and clear spacing with a strong product anchor.
activeTrends.typography: Neutral modern sans with precise data hierarchy.
activeTrends.palette: Cool Blue #D7EFFF supported by navy, white and the exact brand colors.
activeTrends.texture: Soft matte surfaces and restrained translucency.
activeTrends.avoid: Generic SaaS glassmorphism, excessive blur and low-contrast text.

activeTrends.label: Persimmon Impact
activeTrends.signal: Warm red-orange accents are gaining visibility across fashion, design and campaign imagery.
activeTrends.layout: One energetic diagonal or cropped color field balanced by stable information blocks.
activeTrends.typography: Bold condensed display type with disciplined small sans-serif facts.
activeTrends.palette: Persimmon #FF5C34 as an accent only, adapted to brand compatibility.
activeTrends.texture: Matte ink, screen-print density or practical colored light.
activeTrends.avoid: Full-canvas orange overload, fire effects and oversaturated AI glow.

activeTrends.label: Wasabi Utility Accent
activeTrends.signal: Acid yellow-green is evolving into a warmer, functional high-visibility accent.
activeTrends.layout: Utility labels, compact fact tags, ruled lines and one high-visibility CTA or data point.
activeTrends.typography: Industrial grotesk or mono accent paired with a clean brand sans.
activeTrends.palette: Wasabi #E9F056 used in small controlled areas with black, white or brand neutrals.
activeTrends.texture: Printed label stock, fabric weave or practical reflective material.
activeTrends.avoid: Gaming-neon clichés, black-and-green overload and illegible fluorescent body text.

activeTrends.label: Jade Organic Precision
activeTrends.signal: Muted jade and biophilic color systems continue to signal natural wellbeing without rustic clichés.
activeTrends.layout: Structured editorial grid with organic curves used only as supporting dividers or masks.
activeTrends.typography: Elegant humanist sans or restrained serif pairing.
activeTrends.palette: Jade #AEB8A0, warm white and exact product/brand colors.
activeTrends.texture: Natural fibers, stone, uncoated stock or subtle botanical shadow.
activeTrends.avoid: Generic leaf borders, scattered ingredients and fake eco claims.

activeTrends.label: Poet Editorial
activeTrends.signal: Bookish, literary and personal-expression aesthetics are influencing fashion and culture visuals.
activeTrends.layout: Magazine-like column rhythm, purposeful margins, intimate crop and one short pull-quote or factual line.
activeTrends.typography: High-contrast editorial serif with a neutral sans; accurate punctuation and generous leading.
activeTrends.palette: Warm white, ink black, muted brand color and one restrained accent.
activeTrends.texture: Book paper, letterpress impression or soft photographic grain.
activeTrends.avoid: Long unreadable paragraphs, vintage cosplay and decorative fake handwriting.

activeTrends.label: Restrained Stripe Architecture
activeTrends.signal: Bold stripes and sculptural shapes are appearing in expressive visual culture.
activeTrends.layout: One directional stripe system that guides the eye toward product and information—not a decorative background.
activeTrends.typography: Strong simple display type aligned to the stripe rhythm.
activeTrends.palette: Two brand-compatible colors plus white or a quiet neutral.
activeTrends.texture: Flat print color or believable painted/set-built surfaces.
activeTrends.avoid: Circus literalism, rainbow clutter, warped products and optical noise behind text.

globalAvoid: copying a specific Pinterest pin, Instagram post, brand campaign or creator
collages or multi-output boards unless explicitly requested
excessive text, crowded modules, more than two font families or multiple competing trend devices
